extracted.name: Grilled Cod with Spinach and Tomatoes
extracted.description: A grilled foil packet of cod with spinach, diced tomato, mozzarella, and seasonings makes a quick and easy weeknight meal that's ready in 20 minutes.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 pinch garlic powder, or to taste
0.25 cup roughly chopped spinach, or to taste
1 tablespoon olive oil, or to taste
1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar, or to taste
1 slice mozzarella cheese, cut into cubes
instruction_lines: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat.

Place cod on a piece of aluminum foil and season with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder. Top cod with spinach, tomato, and onion; season again with salt and black pepper. Drizzle olive oil and balsamic vinegar over cod and top with mozzarella cheese. Fold foil over cod, creating a packet and crimping the edges together to seal.
Cook on the preheated grill until fish flakes easily with a fork, 7 to 9 minutes.
